package probe

import (
	"context"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

// These are the shapes the e2e tier runs: flags the allow-list admits
// (-trimpath, -o and -deps), literal and not, and positional arguments the
// source builds at run time.
func toolchainArguments(ctx context.Context, binaryPath string) error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-o", binaryPath, filepath.Join("..", "..", "cmd", "x"))
	if out, err := build.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		_ = out
		return err
	}

	list := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "go", "list", "-deps", "./cmd/x")
	_, err := list.Output()
	return err
}

// Every flag written out as a literal is one of the allow-list's, so this call
// keeps the exemption as the ones above do.
func toolchainLiteralFlags() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-o", "out", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}
